677o:
The Bachelor of Business (Accounting) will provide students with key business principles and the relevant practical skills necessary to launch a successful career in accounting. The course is accredited by CPA Australia, CA ANZ and ACCA, and offers a direct pathway to professional certification and employment.

Students enrolled in the Bachelor of Business (Accounting) at Kaplan Business School will learn how to:

  • Identify, measure and analyse accounting and other related information from various sources.
  • Communicate accounting advice and holistic solutions to both accountants and non-accountants.
  • Exercise judgement and critically apply accounting knowledge to solve routine problems in collaborative and individual contexts.
  • Apply accounting knowledge to solve problems within social, ethical, economic, legal, regulatory and international contexts.
  • Acknowledge and consider the ethical implications when solving routine accounting processes and practice.
28ko:
Program Description

The Bachelor of Business (Accounting) provides students with key business principles and the relevant practical skills necessary to launch a successful career in accounting. The course is accredited by CPA Australia, CA ANZ and ACCA, and offers a direct pathway to professional certification and employment.

Upon successful completion graduates are eligible for admission into professional programs offered by CPA Australia, CA ANZ and ACCA. Students may also qualify for credit towards Kaplan Business School's Masters courses, or another course with an alternative higher education provider in Australia.
28je: In today’s increasingly mobile world, hospitality and tourism is becoming one of the largest global industries. Within Kaplan Business School's Bachelor of Business (Hospitality & Tourism Management), students will acquire business communication skills, financial literacy and a host of other transferable skills. Whether a student wishes to work as a consultant, or to start their own business, this degree provides an excellent platform for a business career.
28jf:
Program Description

Kaplan Business School's Bachelor of Business (Management) degree equips students with the essential knowledge and skills to become respected managers of people in a professional environment. The insights students gain will be relevant to any industry and will empower each student to build productive, ethical and successful teams and organisations.

Graduates of this Business Management degree can pursue exciting career paths.

Successful completion of the Bachelor of Business (Management) may qualify students for credit towards Kaplan Business School's range of Masters courses, or another course with an alternative higher education provider in Australia.
28jd: The Bachelor of Business (Marketing) is ideal for students who wish to embark on a career as a marketing professional. Students will be equipped with the foundational knowledge and practices within the increasingly strategic, diverse and evolving field of marketing. This course helps students acquire workplace skills in research, problem-solving, innovation, optimisation and strategy.
5y2p: The Bachelor of Information Technology will help students achieve a comprehensive understanding of information technology in technical and business management areas. Students will develop applications, frameworks, products and services for growing areas such as analytics and cyber security. They will also learn how business problems can be solved by applying a range of technological and programming concepts and tools, and how to effectively communicate these solutions to diverse stakeholders. Additionally, they will be taught how to safeguard data and information, create and manage databases and ensure the ethical handling of business information.
28jh:
Program Description

The Master of Accounting is ideal for students who wish to extend their studies beyond traditional accounting to also encompass the increasingly critical role of business analytics, while also being eligible for membership with a professional accounting body. Throughout this degree, students will develop general management skills and knowledge related to contemporary accounting issues, data analysis and associated practices. Graduates will be able to analyse accounting effectively and strategically within a range of theories and frameworks.
28jm:
Program Description

The Master of Business Analytics is for students who have an objective to become genuine specialists in their profession and are therefore seeking a level of study that will deepen their expertise and enhance their professionalism. As a result, the diversity of their skillset is expanded significantly, the outcome of which is a well-rounded business analyst highly regarded by employers across any industry.

The course is designed so that students are eligible for substantial credits into recognised postgraduate courses in Australia that specialise in business analytics or that have space for unspecified electives.
28kb:
Program Description

The Master of Business Analytics (Extension) is designed for students with an ambition to further their career within the business analytics industry, which is why they will be taught how to build and manage expert teams and to strategically oversee data-driven initiatives. This will culminate in a complex body of knowledge and skills, all of which will produce graduates who are ready for the next stage of their career.

The course is designed so that students are eligible for substantial credits into recognised postgraduate courses in Australia that specialise in business analytics or that have space for unspecified electives.
7z0n:
The Master of Business Analytics (Information Technology) is designed for students with a drive to excel in both business analytics and IT, providing them with the technical and strategic skills needed to thrive in a data-driven world. This carefully structured program, aligned with the Master of Business Analytics (Extension) and the Master of Information Technology (Extension), ensures that graduates develop a comprehensive of knowledge from both fields. The program requires students to choose from our suite of MBA elective subjects, which culminates in a holistic qualification that prepares students for the next stage of their career, equipped to lead and innovate in their chosen field.

Upon graduation, students will not only qualify for a wide range of industry roles in Business Analytics but also careers in IT-related fields such as Cyber Security and Programming.
5y2z: The Master of Information Technology is suitable for students who want to develop the technical efficiency to become a sought-after expert in a high-growth industry. It will provide students with the ability to apply a range of technological and programming concepts and tools to implement IT-related business solutions to industry problems. They will learn how to communicate complex technological problems, solutions and outcomes to diverse stakeholders. They will also be taught how to safeguard the privacy of data and information, create and manage databases and ensure the ethical handling of business information. The course will enable students to graduate with the skills to construct, manage and operate in diverse expert teams to oversee technological initiatives.
5y31: The Master of Information Technology (Extension) is suitable for students who would like to investigate business opportunities by applying a range of technological and programming concepts and tools. Students will learn how to formulate, advise and implement business solutions via the aid of technology-based approaches and to communicate complex solutions and outcomes to diverse stakeholders clearly and effectively. Additionally, students will become adept at creating collaborative technological strategies based on current real-world case studies. Students will also be taught how to apply a technical mindset when evaluating ethical, privacy and information security issues regarding technology. The course will enable them to graduate with the ability to construct, manage and operate in diverse expert teams to oversee technological initiatives.
28ji: The Master of Professional Accounting is an internationally recognised qualification and offers a pathway towards professional accreditation. Students of this qualification develop a comprehensive understanding of accounting principles while improving their critical thinking, analytical and corporate governance skills. Graduates of this degree are eligible for admission into professional programs offered by CPA Australia, CA ANZ and ACCA. Students may also apply for credit into Kaplan Business School's Master of Business Administration course, or a related graduate degree at another Australian higher education provider.
28jo:
The Master of Business Administration (MBA) is widely regarded as the preferred qualification for professionals wanting to pursue a career in strategic management. An MBA can help students advance their careers, expand their professional networks, offer higher earning potential and develop their leadership skills

Students have the opportunity to tailor their degree by selecting electives aligned to their interests and career requirements. In addition to their general MBA, Kaplan Business School offers seven specialisations to choose from:

  • Women in Leadership
  • Project Management
  • Digital Management
  • Tourism and Hospitality Leadership
  • Health Services Management
  • Entrepreneurship
  • International Leadership

This qualification is designed to provide students with valuable practical management skills that will allow them to develop their capability to lead and inspire others in a global business environment.

The Master of Business Administration (MBA) is widely regarded as the preferred qualification for professionals wanting to pursue a career in strategic management. An MBA can advance student career, expand student professional network, offer higher earning potential and develop your leadership skills.

Our MBA program has been acknowledged globally in the 2020 PIEoneer awards for its innovative and future-focused content delivery.

Student will have the opportunity to tailor degree by selecting electives aligned to interests and career requirements. If student would like to focus on a particular field, we offer eight specialisations to choose from:

Data-driven Leadership

Project Management

Health Services Management

Tourism and Hospitality Leadership

Digital Management

Entrepreneurship

International Leadership

Women in Leadership

Students enrolled in the Master of Business Administration at Kaplan Business School will learn how to:

Apply knowledge related to fundamental business processes to make effective business decisions in a global context

Integrate business knowledge to take well-reasoned action in diverse situations

Innovate to address business issues and opportunities in dynamic environments

Demonstrate the leadership necessary to accomplish business goals and maximize organisational performance

Evaluate the ethical and social implications of business decisions in a global context

Program Description

The Master of Business Administration (MBA) is widely regarded as the preferred qualification for professionals wanting to pursue a career in strategic management. In this specialisation (Entrepreneurship) students will learn how to incorporate entrepreneurial activities within their existing organisations or gain the tools needed to launch their own successful start-up businesses.

Whilst there are many career opportunities available to general MBA graduates, such as management and consulting, a specialisation in Entrepreneurship opens additional doors that previously may have been shut.
